اعتملن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَلْنَ (iʕtamalna) /iʕ.ta.mal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# اِعْتَمِلْنَ (iʕtamilna) /iʕ.ta.mil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
